hostname ix-v11
!
ip route default Tunnel0.0
!
ipv6 route 2001:db8:100::/48 fe80::2%GigaEthernet0.0
!
ipv6 access-list v6-sample-in permit icmp src any dest any
ipv6 access-list v6-sample-in permit udp src any sport eq 547 dest any dport eq 546
ipv6 access-list v6-sample-in permit tcp established src any dest any
ipv6 access-list v6-sample-in deny ip src any dest any
ipv6 prefix-list pl6-sample 5 permit 2001:db8::/32 max 64
!
ipv6 router ospf 1
  router-id 198.51.100.254
  network GigaEthernet1.0 area 0
  network Loopback0.0 area 0
  passive-interface GigaEthernet1.0
  redistribute static
!
ipv6 dhcp enable
!
ipv6 dhcp client-profile pd-sample
  ia-pd subscriber GigaEthernet1.0 ::1/64
!
ipv6 dhcp server-profile dhcpv6-sample-lan
  dns-server 2001:db8::53
  dns-server dhcp
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description IPoE sample
  ipv6 address autoconfig receive-default
  ipv6 enable
  ipv6 filter v6-sample-in 1 in
  ipv6 dhcp client pd-sample
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description LAN sample
  ip address 192.0.2.1/24
  ipv6 nd ra enable
  ipv6 nd ra other-config-flag
  ipv6 nd ra dns-server 2001:db8::53 1800
  ipv6 dhcp server dhcpv6-sample-lan
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  ip address 198.51.100.254/32
  ipv6 address 2001:db8::1/128
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  description DS-Lite sample
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  tunnel mode 4-over-6
  tunnel source GigaEthernet0.0
  tunnel destination fqdn aftr.example.jp
  no shutdown
!
